The rooms were not clean, the hotel staff were not friendly, the food was pathetic, the bathroom was not clean, the TV was outdated with a poor quality relay, the air conditioner was not working and there were no face and hand towels and definitely NOT value for money. The location of this hotel is also in a poor.
Please do not be lured by the pictures posted by this hotel. I will NOT recommend this hotel.

Samrat Residency is located in a rather shady and hard-to-reach area. The hotel itself feels quite dodgy — not ideal for families at all. The rooms are tiny, the furniture is crawling with cockroaches, and it seems like pest control hasn’t been done in ages. Some rooms have ACs locked at a fixed temperature, which you can’t adjust. Honestly, I have no idea how this place managed to get such good reviews — it’s completely undeserved.
